news.title: Indego e-bikes dominate Philadelphia bike-share fleet
news.snippet: Indego e-bikes now make up about 70% of Philadelphia's bike-share fleet, raising concerns among some riders about cost and classic bike availability.

news.title: None of Five E-Bike Subscription Services Warn Before Auto-Billing
news.snippet: None of five major Korean shared e-bike operators notify users before auto-billing, the Korea Consumer Agency said, as complaints jumped 148% last year.

news.title: Lime partners with BHN Extras to offer eBike subscriptions through Cycle to Work
news.snippet: The Lime Annual Subscription, which includes a 500-minute monthly allowance, costs £635 per year (£52.92 per month) before tax savings.
